method: Single-reviewer visual reference, recorded before tracker runs. Ten uniform spot-check timestamps per clip (0.0, 0.3, ..., 2.7 s). Approximate ball centre/radius in the native tracking canvas; about 2–4 pixels localization uncertainty. Partial balls and dark frames with unclear boundaries are unscorable. The active ball is distinguished from static background balls.
position_match_rule: Predicted centre must be within reference radius + 4 pixels. This checks whether the visible ball was selected, not precise trajectory accuracy.
contact_match_rule: One-to-one proposals within 0.15 seconds of clear reference contacts. Ambiguous contacts are excluded rather than invented.
